application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1. Ash Tree	Front Garden:

Fell in sections to ground level and treat the stump with eco-plugs to help prevent regrowth.

(Poor twin-stemmed specimen)

The tree's current height is 11m, and its crown spread is 6m
After the proposed works, the tree's height is 0.0m, and the crown spread is 0.0m
decision_conditions:
THIS IS A FORMAL NOTICE to let you know that on 09 April 2026 the Council made the above Tree Preservation Order No. TP26/0004.

The Council has made the Order on the following grounds:

A Section 211 notice (PA26/0640) was received by the Council proposing the removal of the ash tree located in the front garden of the property. A Council Arboricultural Officer carried out an onsite assessment of the proposed tree works.

The tree occupies a highly prominent position on the frontage and forms a strong visual component of the street scene. It provides public amenity due and is clearly visible from multiple public viewpoints along the a316. The justification submitted for its removal refers to the tree being a "poor twinstemmed specimen" but no arboricultural evidence has been provided to demonstrate structural weakness, physiological decline or an imminent risk of failure. No inspection report, decay assessment or structural diagnosis accompanies the notification. The proposal seeks complete removal of a healthy and visually significant tree, which would result in an immediate and permanent loss of amenity. Replacement planting cannot replicate the established presence and landscape value of this tree in the short or medium term.

The loss of this tree would therefore have a notable detrimental impact upon the local and wider landscape. The justification that has been provided is insufficient to demonstrate that the tree requires removal, and it is considered expedient in the interest of amenity to safeguard the tree with this Tree Preservation Order.
